_comment: SECRET. A character's lifespan - how many scenes they have in them in total. Kept out of _maps/npcs/registry.json on purpose: the registry entry is what /enact loads in order to PLAY a character, so a span sitting there would put the number in context at exactly the moment it must not be. /enact must never open this file. Ask scripts/horizon.py instead, which answers with a coarse band (early/established/late/final) and never the number. Rolled once by scripts/roll_lifespan.py and never rerolled - the sole exception is backfilling a character whose recorded history already exceeds the roll (see /character Step 5). The matching 'lived' counter stays in the registry, because how many scenes someone has had is just their history and no secret at all. See _lore/facts/life_is_finite.md.
